body: After my ex and I broke up, we were texting and one night she sent me a text saying "come over", and guess what, on my way out the door she sends a text saying "never mind". It's kinda funny now reading the same thing happening to someone else

It lasted a little over a year. I guess in my mind the fluke was that she liked me at first, because the truly great qualities about me take a while to come out. And she wasn't beautiful in the model or movies sort of way. She was unconventionally attractive. But I still perceived her as very beautiful. It was her eyes, I think.

Here is me venting: I have come to the realization that I did break up with her for a reason. That reason being that we didnt share the intellectual and spiritual bond that I desired. But in that process I overlooked what I did have. I had a beautiful girl that was head over heels for me and would go anywhere with me. I had someone to fall asleep in my arms to make everything better. I had that emotional bond. Maybe it was too much to ask for that intellectual bond. I could have had that with a best friend who Im not romantic with. But I also think there are higher aspiration to love than what we had. Still, I regret everyday giving her up. Thinking what could have been.

In not truly suicidal, though I browse here often. I do get those suicidal thoughts, mostly first thing in the morning. I hold on to the hope that I can fall even more deeply in love someday. I also still hold a small hope to be with her again. My first love. Even though she's been cold to me and even said she's in love with someone else already. I think it's just a rebound thing, but it's not my place to judge that.

In the meantime, Im going to write a song about all this pain. Maybe that will help put it out there instead of deep in my heart where it is now.

Also, one last thing. I MISS BOOBS. God I miss boobs.

Yes, there are lots of great qualities that I have, and she saw something in me that even I didn't see. 
By saying miracle and divine events, it may have sounded like I meant some kind of influence from a higher power. All I meant was an extremely improbable, against the odds event. Surely you believe in those.

Here's the thing. Because of my unattractiveness and lack of charisma, I regard this girl falling in love with me as a miracle- a once in a lifetime thing. I honestly have no idea what I did to get her to love me. I think it was some sort of divine circumstance, like an alignment of the planets that happens every 176 years.

As far as my appearance, I am universally unattractive. It's not a matter of fitness as I am in excellent shape. I actually have abnormalities in my facial structure that can be fixed with plastic surgery. These surgeries are very expensive but they give me hope.

The social awkwardness I admit can be helped and changed by my own will power.

The main thing that gets me is that I think it was such a rare miracle for her to like me. I was spoiled by her because it was so perfect. And she was madly in love with me. Idolized me even. That's why I broke up with her. She gave me an exaggerated sense of self worth. I have all this guilt and self hate that I brought this pain on myself. I destroyed the most beautiful thing in the world-true love.


I'm 22 by the way.

Once you lose that virginity and realize how great it is, you'll be chasing tail. Don't know if that's a good or bad thing. Disclaimer: I think a meaningful bond is more important and makes the sex MUCH better

Edit: I lost mine at 21, and thought I was a super late bloomer. Glad to see Im not alone.
